teaches: `protection` is the number subtracted from every wound before it reaches a characteristic.
`requireSkill` and `requireSkillLevel` are the pair behind the armour DM: a wearer short of the level takes a penalty on every check.
`processing` on an armour is what lets a suit run software — `null` means it runs none.
demo.trap: `requireSkill` matches an owned skill Item by name, so it reads `Demo — Vacc Suit` and not `Vacc Suit`. A name that matches nothing silently penalises everyone who wears it.

system.description: A patrol vest over a sealed liner. Enough against a boat hook, and rated for a wet deck.

options.note: Sealed liner, one hour of air
